D: A bike messenger races across Manhattan with a package someone will kill for.
P: Serve the mains when Wilee hits the first red light and keeps going.
S: Melt butter, honey and brown sugar, stir through oats, chopped dates, peanuts and seeds, press into a tin, bake at 170C for 25 minutes, cool before cutting.
Steamed bao filled with char siu: pork neck marinated in hoisin, honey and five spice, roasted at 200C and glazed, chopped.
M: Wilee's halal cart chicken over rice
one hand on the bars, eaten between drops

Chicken thighs marinated in lemon, oregano, cumin and coriander, griddled and chopped, over turmeric rice with shredded lettuce, white sauce (mayo, yoghurt, vinegar, sugar, pepper) and hot sauce. Marinate 800g chicken thighs in lemon, oregano, cumin and coriander for an hour. Griddle and chop. Cook 300g rice with 1 tsp turmeric. Mix 100g yoghurt, 100g mayo, 1 tbsp vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and pepper. Serve on shredded lettuce with hot sauce.

Crisp-bottomed pork and cabbage dumplings steamed under a lid, with black vinegar, ginger and chilli oil for dipping. Salt 200g finely chopped wombok for 10 minutes and squeeze dry. Mix with 400g pork mince, 2 sliced spring onions, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil. Fill 32 gow gee wrappers and pleat shut. Fry in 2 tbsp oil for 2 minutes until golden underneath, add 80ml water, cover and steam 6 minutes. Serve with black vinegar mixed with shredded ginger and chilli oil.
W: Brown butter choc chip cookies, dough rested overnight, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, flaky salt.
K: Wilee's bike has no brakes, so drink fast

Blend banana, frozen berries, oats, peanut butter, milk and a shot of espresso until smooth. Blend 2 bananas, 250g frozen berries, 40g rolled oats, 2 tbsp peanut butter and 800ml milk until completely smooth. Add a shot of espresso for anyone riding through traffic. Pour into four tall glasses and drink straight away.

steps.text: Melt the butter, honey and brown sugar together.
Stir through the oats, dates, peanuts and seeds.
Press into a lined tin and bake at 170C.
Cool completely before cutting into bars.

dishes.make_ahead: Pork up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Mix the hoisin, honey, soy and five spice and coat the pork.
Marinate in the fridge overnight, at least 4 hours.
Roast at 200C, basting with the marinade.
Rest the pork, then chop.
Steam the bao buns until soft and fill with the pork.

veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days, keep chilled

ingredients.item: tinned young jackfruit in brine, drained

steps.text: Squeeze the jackfruit dry and shred it with two forks, cutting away any tough core.
Mix the hoisin, honey, soy and five spice, toss through the jackfruit and leave for 30 minutes.
Spread on a tray brushed with the neutral oil and roast at 200C for 25 minutes, stirring halfway, until sticky and catching at the edges.
Steam the bao buns until soft and fill with the jackfruit.

dishes.n: Wilee's halal cart chicken over rice
dishes.make_ahead: Marinate the chicken in the lemon juice and spices up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; mix the white sauce up to 2 days ahead and cook the rice and chicken on the night

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in the lemon juice, oregano, cumin and coriander.
Cook the rice with the turmeric.
Mix the yoghurt, mayo, vinegar, sugar and pepper into a white sauce.
Griddle the chicken until cooked through, then chop.
Serve on shredded lettuce with rice, white sauce and hot sauce.

veg.n: Wilee's halal cart tofu over rice
veg.make_ahead: Marinate the tofu slabs up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; mix the white sauce up to 2 days ahead and cook the rice and tofu on the night

steps.text: Cut the tofu into thick slabs and marinate in the lemon juice, oregano, cumin and coriander.
Cook the rice with the turmeric.
Mix the yoghurt, mayo, vinegar, sugar and pepper into a white sauce.
Griddle the tofu in the oil until crisp on both sides, then chop.
Serve on shredded lettuce with rice, white sauce and hot sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Dough up to 2 days, baked cookies up to 3 days

steps.text: Brown the butter and cool.
Beat with the sugar and egg, then mix in the flour, bicarb and choc chips.
Rest the dough overnight in the fridge.
Roll into 16 balls on lined trays.
Bake at 180C and sprinkle with flaky salt.

dishes.make_ahead: Best blended just before drinking; portion the bananas and berries into a bag in the freezer up to 1 week ahead

steps.text: Blend the bananas, berries, oats, peanut butter and milk until completely smooth.
Add a shot of espresso for anyone riding through traffic.
Pour into four tall glasses and drink straight away.

s.how: Melt 100g butter, 80g honey and 80g brown sugar. Stir through 250g oats, 100g chopped dates, 80g peanuts and 40g mixed seeds. Press into a lined tin and bake at 170C for 25 minutes. Cool completely before cutting into bars.

Marinate 600g pork neck in 4 tbsp hoisin, 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp five spice overnight. Roast at 200C for 35 minutes, basting with the marinade, rest and chop. Steam 12 bao buns for 8 minutes and fill with the pork.

w.how: Brown 150g butter and cool. Beat with 200g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour, half a tsp bicarb and 200g choc chips. Rest overnight in the fridge. Roll into 16 balls, bake at 180C for 10 minutes and sprinkle with flaky salt.
